main.description: Searches indexed Certified profiles by text, optionally restricted to actor DIDs. Filters combine with AND; values in the actor array are ORed. Authentication is not required.

search.description: Trimmed text is matched literally and case-insensitively as a substring in displayName or description. Blank text is unrestricted.

sortDirection.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt, falling back to row creation time; URI breaks ties. Default desc.

actors.description: Actor DIDs to include; values are ORed and handles are not resolved.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep parameters unchanged between pages. Pages are not a snapshot.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter or pagination parameter is invalid, repeated where scalar, or unsupported.

errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when pagination is complete.
